privacy.lead: Here we explain what details you give us when you send a request, and what we do with them.

sections.title: What details we receive
sections.text: What you fill in when you send a request. For home cleaning, move-out cleaning, deep cleaning and window cleaning: service, size of your home or number of windows, how often, preferred date and time, address, notes, name, email address and mobile number. For business quotes: type of premises, area, how often, company or association, contact person, email address, phone number and message.

sections.title: Why we use the details
sections.text: We use the details to answer your request, for example with a suggested time and price.

sections.title: What is stored on the website
sections.text: The website has no database and does not store what you send. It goes to us as an email, and you get a copy.

sections.title: Hosting: Vercel
sections.text: The website is run by Vercel, which is a data processor for us. Vercel keeps standard hosting logs of visits to the website.

sections.title: Email service: Resend
sections.text: We send email with the service Resend (EU region), which is a data processor for us. What you send goes through Resend on its way to us and to you.
